g.id: Land cover layer with a Manning n for each class
Merge terrain: site survey, 2 m drone DTM, 5 m NSA DTM, design surfaces of dam, basin and dikes
Mesh: 10 to 20 m cells, 5 m near the dam, breaklines on dikes, roads and wadi banks
Two 2D flow areas: the reservoir and the wadi down to the sea
2D connection = the dam: crest 95.5 m, ogee 84.5 m over 200 m, breach data
Initial condition: fill the reservoir to the scenario pool and hold it
Boundary conditions: inflow hydrograph upstream, tide level at the sea
Computation: full shallow water equations, adaptive time step, Courant about 1
Checks: volume error under 1 percent, no instabilities, peak against the hand estimate
RAS Mapper outputs: depth, velocity, D x V, arrival time, hazard class
